title: Hilachas
description: Hilachas is a dish from Guatemala prepared with beef flank steak, yellow onion, garlic, tomato. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used.

steps.instruction: Pat the main ingredients dry. Brown in a hot heavy pan in batches for about 12 minutes, turning to color all sides.
Add the braising liquid and seasonings, cover and cook gently for about 105 minutes until the meat is tender and safely cooked.
Shred the fully cooked meat into thin pieces with clean forks, discarding bones and tough connective tissue.
Chop the vegetables as needed. Sauté the listed ingredients over medium heat, stirring, for about 12 minutes until softened and aromatic.
Combine the remaining ingredients, cover partly and stew gently for about 20 minutes until the flavors meld and everything is tender.
